ShaderNodePreset.Description: Two-point affine temporal stabilizer for relative depth maps. Feed raw model output, before any inversion or falloff curve. Video: https://www.youtube.com/live/5Ctu55gq2Ec Contact: sinan@sinanvural.com
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Depth Temporal Stabilizer

Uniform.ToolTip: Sample point 1. Drag the axis in the viewer, or paste Action tracker curves with Action Coords on.
Uniform.Name: point1

Uniform.ToolTip: Sample point 2. Drag the axis in the viewer, or paste Action tracker curves with Action Coords on.
Uniform.Name: point2

Uniform.ToolTip: Value the depth map should read at point 1. Pick this off the raw input on your reference frame: colour picker, Front view (F1).
Uniform.Name: target1

Uniform.ToolTip: Value the depth map should read at point 2. Pick it the same way as Target 1. Keep well separated from Target 1. Swapping the targets or the points inverts the map.
Uniform.Name: target2

Uniform.ToolTip: How far apart the two samples must read, as a fraction of their depth: 0.1 is 10 percent. Closer than this, the solve fades to a flat map rather than exploding. Raise it if close points give harsh contrast.
Uniform.Name: minSep

Uniform.ToolTip: Enable when pasting Action tracker data, which reports pixel positions relative to image centre. Leave off when dragging the on-screen axes. The axes will not line up with the image while this is on, so check placement with Show Markers.
Uniform.Name: centerOrigin

Uniform.ToolTip: Draw the sample footprints: red for point 1, green for point 2. Turn off before rendering.
Uniform.Name: showMarkers

Uniform.ToolTip: Averaging radius in pixels. Large enough to reject model noise, small enough to stay on one surface.
Uniform.Name: sampleRadius

Uniform.ToolTip: Distance passes the stabilized depth through, Near/Far normalizes a window to 0-1, Range isolates a band.
Uniform.Name: rangeMode

Uniform.ToolTip: Near bound of the window. Values at or below this go to black.
Uniform.Name: nearVal

Uniform.ToolTip: Far bound of the window. Values at or above this go to white.
Uniform.Name: farVal

Uniform.ToolTip: Curve shaping the Near/Far ramp. 1.0 is linear, above 1 pushes detail toward Far, below 1 toward Near.
Uniform.Name: nfFalloff

Uniform.ToolTip: Width of the fully white band around the selected depth.
Uniform.Name: rangeWidth

Uniform.ToolTip: Softness of both edges of the band.
Uniform.Name: rangeFalloff
